name: Junior Lifeguard Cadets (Ages 14 to 17)
city: Hayward, CA (Don Castro Regional Recreation Area)
what_you_do: You join a two week summer lifeguard training session in Hayward at Don Castro Regional Recreation Area. Cadets 15 and older can earn Red Cross lifeguard, CPR and AED certification. Younger cadets can earn a CPR and AED card.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17. The program page does not list a swim test or a home city rule.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program page. Financial aid is offered through the Regional Parks Foundation Campership program.
duration: 2 weeks per session, about 4 sessions each summer
deadline_text: The program page said 2026 cadet applications were due May 6 and accepted cadets had to register by June 12. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Download the Junior Cadet application packet from the program page. Turn it in by the deadline. If you are picked, register by the second deadline.
notes: This is a training class, not a paid job. Sessions are full day only. The program page does not list session dates. It also lists Junior Lifeguards for ages 8 to 12 and Junior Lifeguard Aides for ages 13 to 15, with no details. Call 1-888-327-2757. For lifeguard jobs at age 16 and older, see the district lifeguard jobs page.
